sources.title: Constraints on Axion Mediated Dipole-Dipole Interactions
Limits on axions and axionlike particles within the axion window using a spin-based amplifier
sources.role: published electron-neutron dipole experiment; paper uses neutron fraction 0.73

sources.title: Nuclear spin content and constraints on exotic spin-dependent couplings
sources.qualification: the source documents substantial model spread and warns that the small non-valence proton fraction in heavy odd-neutron nuclei is not robust

experimentalBoundary.available: the 2022 129Xe experiment supplies an independent isotope response direction and a published one-coupling electron-neutron curve
experimentalBoundary.missing: a common-mass numerical likelihood or response table reinterpreted with both neutron and proton spin fractions and their nuclear-theory covariance
experimentalBoundary.decision: 21Ne plus 129Xe can in principle separate c_n and c_p, but the 2.2-degree row separation gives condition number 52.4 before experimental and nuclear-model uncertainties. This is a fragile tomography path, not a current precision reconstruction.
